Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL2971. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records to activities to assays to target_dictionary. Filter assays.assay_organism equals Homo sapiens and target_dictionary.chembl_id equals CHEMBL2971. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
